10. Learned Advocate for the petitioner further submits that the trial court after framing proper issues discussed all the issues and decided the same based upon the evidence and the exhibits on record but the appellate court without proper reversal of those findings of the trial court allowed the appeal without deciding those issues not based upon the correct appreciation of the law and facts of the case. Thus, the appellate court committed an error of law which occasioned a failure of justice. 

 22. Since, the impugned judgment is a judgment of reversal, let us examine the judgment passed by the courts below.
